key_insight: Stateful deception aims to make attackers spend more than defenders by preserving a coherent, isolated world for each recognized adversary.
engineering_relevance: Pair deterministic state management with a constrained LLM renderer to control decoy costs without relying on the model to store state.
method: Define a Deception Exchange Rate linking mission-weighted attacker effort to defender resource expenditure.
Specify persistent, adversary-specific worlds that remain consistent across return visits.
Combine Cowrie with a local LLM for SSH deception, optimizing deterministic handling and prompts.
evidence_signal: Across five open-weight models, deterministic-layer and prompt optimizations reduced per-session defender cost by around 63% versus a naive all-LLM decoy.
watch_item: The evaluation measures defender costs only; per-adversary state and attacker effort are specified but not yet measured, leaving the full exchange benefit unverified.
paper_title: Make the Adversary Spend More: Stateful Deception as a Cost-Exchange Primitive for AI-Era Cyber Defense
